# Demo kit: palletizer-lite

Generated by `tools/build_kit.py` (PLAN 2.14); do not edit the generated files by hand,
rebuild them. OpenFactory is a training and demo tool, not a safety-rated simulation.

## Generated files

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `palletizer-lite.yaml` | the scene (copied from `scenes/`) |
| `palletizer-lite.float32.modbus.yaml` | Modbus address lockfile, float32 analogs (ADR-0004) |
| `palletizer-lite.int16_scaled.modbus.yaml` | Modbus address lockfile, int16_scaled (OpenPLC) |
| `palletizer-lite.st` | OpenPLC program (copied from `examples/openplc/`) |
| `palletizer-lite.py` | stand-in PLC script (copied from `examples/pyplc/`) |
| `palletizer-lite-io.csv` | I/O list, float32 Modbus addresses |
| `palletizer-lite-io-int16.csv` | I/O list, int16_scaled Modbus addresses (OpenPLC) |
| `palletizer-lite-tags.L5X` | Studio 5000 controller tag stubs (PLAN 2.3) |
| `palletizer-lite-ignition-tags.json` | Ignition 8.3 tags, a UDT instance per component (PLAN 2.4) |
| `palletizer-lite-grafcet.html` | GRAFCET of the OpenPLC program, pending PE review (PLAN 2.8) |
| `palletizer-lite.ofrec` | a 60 s recording under the stand-in script (PLAN 2.12) |
| `README.md` | this index |

## Use it

```bash
uv run openfactory run kits/palletizer-lite/palletizer-lite.yaml --script kits/palletizer-lite/palletizer-lite.py
uv run openfactory replay kits/palletizer-lite/palletizer-lite.ofrec      # no scene or PLC needed
uv run openfactory run kits/palletizer-lite/palletizer-lite.yaml --opcua  # Ignition: docs/ignition.md
```

With OpenPLC, load `palletizer-lite.st` and configure its Slave Device from
`palletizer-lite-io-int16.csv` (docs/guides/openplc-quickstart.md).
